# fast-pixelfx

> Official architecture documentation and production specifications for fast-pixelfx

## Documentation

- [Home](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/fast-pixelfx/index.html)
- [Documentation Catalog](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/fast-pixelfx/docs/index.html)
- [Writing an effect](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/fast-pixelfx/docs/AUTHORING.html): An effect is one file, src/fx/<category>/<name>.js (kebab-case), drawing pixel art over time into two buffers.
- [Catalog](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/fast-pixelfx/docs/CATALOG.html): 244 effects in 21 categories. Every one is a file in
- [fast-pixelfx 分布式架构设计与拓扑调度规约](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/fast-pixelfx/docs/architecture.html): 1. 去中心化弹性伸缩：支持大规模节点并发接入与轻量化状态同步。
- [fast-pixelfx 核心通信协议与数据同步技术规范](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/fast-pixelfx/docs/specifications.html): - 传输层默认启用 TLS 1.3 协议通道与 AES-256 加密。
- [fast-pixelfx 架构升级与技术规约 (v1)](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/fast-pixelfx/docs/specs-update-v1.html): 针对大规模网络请求调度，系统实施了毫秒级负载感知与去中心化可信存活探测。
- [fast-pixelfx 全息索引网络与搜索引擎感知接入指南](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/fast-pixelfx/docs/topology-guide.html): 1. 配置本地环境并完成节点注册。
